assertion: The Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme (IGMDP), under which DRDO built India's early indigenous missiles, was approved by the Government of India in 1983.
reason: The IGMDP was confined to surface-to-surface ballistic missiles, namely Prithvi and Agni.
explanation: The assertion is true: the IGMDP was approved on 26 July 1983 with Abdul Kalam as its driving figure. The reason is false: the programme covered five systems, Prithvi, Agni, Trishul, Akash and Nag, which include surface-to-air missiles (Trishul, Akash) and an anti-tank missile (Nag).
